apply_temporal_shift: apply a temporal shift to video feature tensors using TSM with configurable channel shift fraction
prepare_inputs: prepare video input tensors for TSM by deducing GPU or TPU mode from the input shape
prepare_outputs: process TSM output tensors by averaging representations over the time axis for classification
temporal_shift_gpu: perform a temporal shift on video features optimized for GPU using slice and pad operations
temporal_shift_tpu: perform a temporal shift on video features optimized for TPU using masked summation to avoid reshape
